# semaphore_ex_global_policy_guardrail_rollback (Action)

Publishes a new policy revision from a prior revision. Requires an explicit reason and the exact current draft revision; conflicts are not retried. Executes only through explicit Action invocation. Progress reports a bounded, non-secret summary.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_global_policy_guardrail_rollback" "example" {
  config {
    revision                = 1
    expected_draft_revision = 2
    reason                  = "Restore reviewed policy"
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_global_policy_guardrail_rollback.example
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expected_draft_revision` (Number)
- `reason` (String) Explicit rollback reason; the server rejects blank, multiline or oversized reasons.
- `revision` (Number)
